analysis.title: Tanger Inc. (SKT): 3Q26 First Take: Slight FFO beat and guidance raise, as leasing momentum remains healthy
key_insights: SKT reported 3Q26 FFO of $0.64/share, in line with GSe of $0.64 and +1.6% above FactSet consensus of $0.63.

SKT raised 2026 FFO/share guidance to $2.49-$2.53 from $2.45-$2.52, lifting the midpoint ~1.0% to $2.51, in line with GSe and consensus. GS reads the raise as largely anticipated and expects SKT to trade in line with REITs on Thursday 11/5.
SKT raised the low end of 2026 same center NOI growth guidance to 3.50%-4.25% from 2.75%-4.25%. YTD same center NOI growth is +3.5% and 3Q26 was +4.2% y/y, so the range implies a pickup in 4Q.
TTM cash leasing spreads were +11.0% on renewed and re-tenanted space, modestly above +10.5% in 2Q26. Re-tenanted space spreads were +28.6% on a cash basis and +12.1% net of tenant allowances.
Re-tenanted space was 10.4% of leasing in 3Q26 vs. 13.1% in 3Q25. New rental rates on re-tenanted space were 61% higher than on renewed space, though property mix affects absolute rent PSF.
Tenant allowance and maintenance capex was $20.7mn in 3Q26 vs. $16.8mn in 3Q25. As a percent of NOI it stays in a 16%-18% range for FY23-FY26E.
TTM tenant sales were $487 PSF, flat q/q and +2.5% y/y. Same center sales PSF were flat q/q and +2.7% y/y.
Same center occupancy was 97.3% at end of 3Q26, +70bps q/q and -10bps y/y. Occupancy cost is 9.7%, same as a year ago.
Bad debt was 28bps of base rent in 3Q26 vs. 29bps in 3Q25. GS models 50bps in 2027.
SKT announced no acquisitions in the quarter. Net debt to EBITDAre of 4.6x leaves capacity to act on opportunities.
GS maintains a Buy with a 12-month price target of $40.00 based on a Q5-Q8 target AFFO multiple of 19.8x. The stock closed at $38.46 on 4 Nov 2026, implying 4.0% upside.

GS questions for the call: how much rent upside remains given 9.7% occupancy cost and tougher comps as SKT laps leases signed in 2022-2023, the renew vs. replace strategy for 2026-2027, timing of permanent backfills of former Saks Off 5th space, and what drives 2027 same center NOI re-acceleration.

market_movers.rationale: Leasing spreads, tenant sales and occupancy remain healthy and guidance was raised. GS expects in-line trading because the raise was anticipated.

sector_views.rationale: Re-tenanted space pricing of +28.6% cash spreads indicates healthy tenant demand and an ability to upgrade tenant mix.

2026 FFO/share guidance raised to $2.49-$2.53 from $2.45-$2.52, midpoint $2.51 (+~1.0%), in line with GSe and consensus estimates.
2026 same center NOI growth guidance low end raised to 3.50%-4.25% from 2.75%-4.25%. 3Q26 same center NOI +4.2% y/y, +3.5% YTD.

risk_factors: Retailer bankruptcies, store closings or fewer openings would raise bad debt and lower occupancy.
Weakness in the outlet channel from shoppers or retailers would limit rent increases.
Lower acquisition volumes or smaller investment spreads would slow earnings growth.
Higher interest rates would raise interest expense.
Tougher lease comps as SKT laps 2022-2023 leases may limit leasing spread upside.

tension_points.bull_case: Re-tenanted space spreads of +28.6% cash and +12.1% net effective, with sales PSF up +2.5% y/y, indicate healthy tenant demand and ability to upgrade the tenant mix.
tension_points.bear_case: SKT is lapping leases signed in 2022-2023 when spreads had already begun to rise, and re-tenanted activity fell to 10.4% of leasing from 13.1%, which may limit further upside.
